200.description:
Server-Sent Events, in this order:

- `run`: the run has started (`run_id`, `mode`, `profile_version`)
- `match_report`: requirement-by-requirement fit, gaps and questions
- `resume`, `cover_letter`, `outreach`: in whichever order they finish
- `done` (`cost_usd`, `duration_ms`) or `error` (`code`, `message`)

Lines starting with `:` are keep-alive comments; ignore them.

The file, named like `Jordan-Rivera-Resume-Figma.pdf`.

Every file is read back the way an ATS would before it is sent. `X-ATS-Check: passed` or `failed` carries the
result; `GET /v1/applications/{id}/ats-check` shows the extracted text and the reasons.
